title: Transparent issue-agent delegation
description:
Make delegated coding-agent work visible, resumable, and reviewable from its Kanbus issue. The router must preserve every agent turn, question, test result, branch, and failure rather than treating a malformed final response as grounds to discard work.

Definition of done:
- Codex sessions are attached to issues and can be resumed from human replies.
- Questions become visible issue comments and move the issue to Blocked.
- Every completed, uncertain, or tapped-out run moves to Review with preserved branch, draft PR, transcript, and evidence.
- The board exposes the conversation and supports human replies.
- Python and Rust behavior remain identical.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Definition of done verified against develop. (1) Session resume from human replies: pending_reply_plan/ResumeMode in rust/src/router.rs and the Python equivalent (cd08d171). (2) Questions become comments and move to Blocked: the blocked outcome path in both runtimes. (3) Completed/uncertain/malformed runs land in Review with preserved evidence: preserve_completed_turn_after_publication_failure in both runtimes. (4) Board exposes the conversation and supports replies: write API #344 plus composer UI #351 (kbs-80e79a). (5) Parity: shared features/router Gherkin run by behave and cucumber, plus tools/check_spec_parity.py in CI. Closing as complete.
